description: Apply a deterministic colour grade to an image already in the project gallery — no re-generation, no provider, no credits. The look is computed pixel-exact (exposure, saturation, hue, lightness, contrast, film grain) and lands as a new gallery image the sequencer and export pick up. For full control the recipe fields are open too: levels and curves per channel (rgb, r, g, b — values 0..255), a gradient map (luminance → colour ramp), exposure offset/gamma and grain seed/colour. Fixed order, like a node stack: exposure → levels → curves → hue/saturation → look (LUT) → gradient map → grain. The same recipe on the same image always yields the same result (grain is fixed-seed), so a look is reproducible across every still. Set from_colorist to start from the project's colorist crew brief (look, contrast, grain) and tune with the sliders on top. At least one adjustment OR from_colorist is required. Synchronous — the graded image_url comes straight back, no polling.

contrast.description: Contrast curve: high is an S-curve, low flattens it

curves.description: Curves per channel as [x, y] points 0..255, x strictly increasing (smooth monotone curve through them). Example warm highlights: {"r": [[0,0],[192,205],[255,255]], "b": [[0,0],[192,180],[255,255]]}. Not together with contrast on the rgb channel

exposure.description: Exposure in stops; positive brightens, zero is neutral

exposure_gamma.description: Exposure gamma; 1 neutral, above 1 brightens midtones

exposure_offset.description: Exposure offset added after the stops (lifts or crushes blacks); zero neutral

from_colorist.description: Start from the project's colorist crew brief (look/contrast/grain), then apply the sliders on top

gradient_map.description: Gradient map: luminance 0..1 → colour ramp, blended with opacity (default 1). Example teal-orange: {"stops": [[0, "#0b2a33"], [0.5, "#7a7a72"], [1, "#ffd9a8"]], "opacity": 0.3}

grain.description: Film grain amount; zero is none, monochrome

grain_mono.description: Grain in black and white (default true); false gives colour grain

grain_seed.description: Seed of the grain pattern (default 0) — same seed, same grain

hue.description: Hue rotation in degrees; zero neutral

image_id.description: Id of the source image in the project gallery (from lab_list_assets / lab_generate)

levels.description: Levels per channel (rgb = all three, r/g/b single), values 0..255: input black/white point, gamma (above 1 brightens midtones), output black/white. Example: {"rgb": {"black": 12, "white": 240, "gamma": 1.1}}

look.description: Named look from the bundle catalogue (e.g. filmlab-neutral, filmlab-warm, filmlab-cool, filmlab-soft, filmlab-punch) — a hand-authored LUT, applied on top of the sliders. The server resolves the name; a path is never accepted.

saturation.description: Colour saturation; minimum is greyscale, zero neutral

name: lab_grade
title: Grade Image
